title: Autonomy Project Team Lead
description:
****Career Area:****
 Technology, Digital and Data
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****Job Description****
 Caterpillar’s Autonomous Mining Technologies is seeking an experienced Autonomy Project Team Lead to drive disciplined project execution and delivery of high\-quality autonomy solutions. This role will streamline team workflows, strengthen DevOps and quality practices, coordinate validation, and build an effective, collaborative team.
   

  

* Own work planning, backlog execution, dependency management, and delivery tracking through Azure DevOps.
* Lead the autonomy project team, remove roadblocks, and maintain alignment to scope, schedule, quality, and business priorities.
* Work with global teams, streamline workflows, governance, reviews, metrics, and reporting to improve predictability and execution efficiency.
* Coordinate L4/L6 validation planning, readiness, resources, issue closure, and objective evidence across stakeholders.
* Drive DevOps, CI/CD, traceability, defect prevention, and continuous improvement practices.
* Identify project risks and process gaps; establish mitigation, contingency, and escalation plans.
* Collaborate with architects, software, systems, test, product, and operations teams to enable integrated delivery.
* Support troubleshooting of automation and process\-control issues by identifying critical parameters, variables, and hazards.
* Ensure automation solutions are designed, commissioned, maintained, and validated for reliable industrial operation.
* Provide clear status communication to stakeholders, leadership, and partner organizations on deliverables with required information radiators setup.
* Mentor, coach, build, scale and develop team members to attain deadlines, while fostering accountability, inclusion, and build strong innovation culture.


**Experience:\-** 
 B.E / B. Tech / M.E / M. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 10\+ years of relevant experience.
   

  

**Required Competencies: \-**
* Experience leading complex autonomy, embedded software, robotics, mining, or industrial automation projects.
* Strong project management capability, including estimation, planning, staffing, monitoring, risk management, and reviews.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps, Agile delivery, backlog management, dashboards, and release coordination.
* Working knowledge of DevOps, software quality, process compliance, configuration management, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience coordinating system and vehicle validation, preferably across L4/L6 test environments.
* Ability to contribute to operational, tactical, and strategic plans and adapt execution when priorities change.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to influence across teams and leadership levels.
* Demonstrated cross\-team integration, stakeholder relationship management, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Proven people leadership with a strong focus on coaching, team building, accountability, and continuous improvement.


****Posting Dates:****
 September 25, 2026 \- October 8, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
   

  

 Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

description:

title: SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
description:
**About Team**
 The Acquisition and Discovery Engineering team at Walmart is dedicated to providing a seamless and delightful shopping experience to millions of shoppers worldwide. As a software engineer in this team, you will have the opportunity to work on top of the funnel shopping experience – Homepage, Content Pages for SEO and SEM, Search \& Browse experiences, Deals and Item pages across mobile and web platforms.
   

  

 This collaborative team made up of Engineering, UX, Product Management, Business and Analytics is rapidly iterating on new products and site features at scale. We deliver high performing solutions on our next generation front\-end platform. Virtual Try\-On, Gen AI integration, personalized complete\-the\-look, Video shopping, etc are just a few examples of the features developed by this team in collaboration with many other teams. Continuous experimentation, innovation and feedback by millions of customers makes this work even more exciting!
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Manage the software development team, including hiring, training, mentoring, and conducting performance evaluations to build a high\-performing organization.
   

  

 Oversee the design, development, and implementation of software applications across various platforms (iOS, Android, Web).
   

  

 Supervise the development of the orchestration layer and changes to microservices backend systems to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
   

  

 Work closely with other teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and collaborate with stakeholders including product managers and designers to deliver high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

 Develop project timelines, allocate resources effectively, and ensure projects are completed on time and within budget while meeting quality standards and customer expectations.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership and guidance to the team, fostering an environment of continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence.
   

  

**What'll You Bring**
 An Engineering Degree \- B.E/B.Tech/MS in any stream – Computer Science preferred.
   

  

 14\+ years of relevant experience, including a minimum of 5 years of experience with agile principles and practices, with proven experience leading Scrum teams.
   

  

 Proven experience in a similar engineering leadership role, preferably within the e\-commerce industry.
   

  

 Extensive knowledge of one of the mobile (iOS, Android) application development platforms and web development (JS frameworks), orchestration layers, interaction with backend systems, and CMS tools.
   

  

 Deep expertise in architecture and design patterns, cloud\-native microservices, and building resilient, reliable, high\-quality software.
   

  

 Strong technical mindset with hands\-on product development experience, the ability to deep\-dive into complex technical issues, and staying current with the latest industry trends and technologies.
   

  

 Strong leadership and team management skills, including matrix management, with the ability to mentor and motivate a high\-performing team.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills, with a creative approach to overcoming challenges.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Excellent project management skills, with a proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Flexible, hybrid work
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal opportunity employer
   

  

 Walmart, inc., is an equal opportunities employer – by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

 Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
   

  

 Option 2: 7 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. 2 years’ supervisory experience.

 Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area., We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2\.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 In this role, as a senior consultant in GDS Consulting, you will lead the implementation of Ciena/ Blue Planet products and integration with the telecommunications operators’ Operations Support Systems (OSS). You will be responsible for ensuring that a quality, integrated software solution is delivered in a timely manner, at budget, and to our client's satisfaction.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery and Product implementation, configuration, extensions, and integrations for OSS systems involving Ciena Blue Planet’s suite of products with specific focus on Blue Planet Network Inventory (BPI).
* Actively drive \& participate in Business Analysis and requirements gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Data Migration and Support.
* You will develop system, process and data requirements of the customer.
* You will map OSS software (Network Inventory) capabilities to those needs and build consensus around the solution, proposes technical solutions to system requirements.
* You will develop applicable process and system change documentation; Develop and distribute project related documentation.
* Write and maintain Java code, create Spring beans, and develop JUnit tests.
* Develop and extend GUI components such as grids and reports using core product modules.
* Adhere to established coding and documentation standards while extending core product components.
* Write and optimize database queries and procedures, primarily for Neo4j, PostgreSQL.
* Support debugging, deployment, and environment setup using tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong technical skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.


**Frontend Development:**
* Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SVG
* Frameworks/Libraries: Angular 2\+, Node.js/npm, Gulp
* Testing: Protractor, Jasmine


**Backend Development:**
* Languages: Java 11\+, J2EE
* Frameworks/Libraries: Maven, Spring (Data, Security, MVC), SpringBoot
* Testing: JUnit


**Databases:**
* Primary: Neo4j (Graph DB), PostgreSQL \+ TimescaleDB


**Additional Skills:**
* ElasticSearch, Camunda / BPMN / OSM / Workflow, Drools, Kafka integration, RESTful APIs (using Spring MVC), Docker, Kubernetes
* Programming Concepts: Algorithms, data structures, database concepts (relational and graph)


**Domain Knowledge:**
* Telecom, OSS (Operational Support Systems), Inventory Management
* Consultant with minimum of 5\+ Years proven experience and significant knowledge in Telecom OSS Network Inventory.
* Experience in Ciena Blue Planet Inventory (BPI).
* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)
* Knowledge of and preferably certification in TMForum’s eTOM framework along with Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and Open APIs.
* Exceptional quantitative skills enabling identification of key business issues and progression of solutions.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.

title: Quality and Process Officer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Quality and Process Officer
   

  

**Department** 
 : CIO Office – COE Operationnal Product follow\-up
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40\.5 billion in 2025\.
   

  

 BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Within the CIO Office, the quality and process referent (QPR) contributes to the reduction of the risks of execution of main IT programs and projects (V model projects or Agile opus) and is force of proposal on the associated remediation plans.
   

  

 The QPR has a portfolio of projects portfolio; he must be able to adapt according to project constraints and be able to carry out his restitutions within the expected deadlines. title: SAP Functional Lead

 The successful candidate will possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, experience managing cross\-functional teams, and the ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
   

  

* 
* Leadership \& Project Delivery
* Lead SAP implementation projects from requirements gathering through go\-live and hypercare support.
* Drive design discussions and ensure timely resolution of functional and technical issues.
* Lead teams through requirement workshops, Fit\-Gap analysis, solution design, testing, deployment, and end\-user training.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and system integrators to ensure successful project delivery.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and high\-performance team culture.


**Solution Design \& Configuration**

* Manage enhancements, interfaces, reports, workflow solutions, and data conversion activities.

**Testing \& Release Management**

* Support release management, cutover planning, deployment, and post\-production stabilization.

**Continuous Improvement \& Support**

* Support operational sustainability and team capability development.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading SAP implementations or major SAP transformation projects.
* Strong knowledge of SAP business processes and system functionality.
* Experience conducting Fit\-Gap analysis, requirements gathering, testing, and user training.
* Experience working with system integrators, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira or similar Agile project management tools.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience with Agile, iterative, and test\-driven delivery methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: BCM-T24-BA - Migration Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Technology Consulting\- BCM – Data Migration BA**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Experienced Business Analyst to join the Data Migration team for a large\-scale Private Banking implementation. The ideal candidate will possess strong domain expertise in private banking products and demonstrate hands\-on experience in data analysis, mapping, and validation processes across complex source and target systems.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Data Migration Strategy: Define and oversee the end\-to\-end migration approach, including ETL processes, data profiling, cleansing, mapping, and reconciliation for Temenos Wealth implementations.
* Technical Expertise: Provide guidance on Temenos T24 architecture, administration, configuration, and data structures, ensuring robust migration solutions.
* Design \& Development Oversight: Supervise development activities using Infobasic, Core Java, EJB, J2EE, and ETL tools (e.g., Informatica) to deliver high\-quality migration components.
* Database Management: Ensure efficient handling of relational and hierarchical databases such as Oracle, DB2, Postgres, MySQL, and MSSQL, including performance tuning and optimization.
* Functional Knowledge: Apply expertise in core banking and wealth modules, including Private Banking, Securities, Accounting, Compliance, AML, and GL structures, to align migration with business requirements.
* Documentation \& Governance: Prepare and validate migration documentation, including strategy papers, data mapping, ETL process flows, and reconciliation reports, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with clients to gather requirements, clarify migration needs, and provide regular progress updates to project managers and technical leads.
* Leadership \& Team Management: Manage large migration teams, mentor resources, and foster a quality\-driven culture while ensuring timely delivery of migration milestones.
* Risk Management: Identify potential migration risks, implement mitigation strategies, and handle critical issues effectively to keep projects on track.
* Pre\-sales \& Planning Support: Contribute to effort estimation, engagement assessments, and pre\-sales activities, while supporting project planning and resource allocation.
* Training \& Knowledge Sharing: Conduct training sessions for clients and internal teams on migration best practices and Temenos tools.
* Other skills include Effort Estimation, Pre\-sales support, engagement Assessments, Project planning, Conduct Training for clients/Internal staff


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* MBA/MCA/ BE / B.Tech/ equivalent with a sound industry experience of 12 to 18 Yrs
* Need to work as a team lead in one or more T24 projects.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the lead
* Regular status reporting to the Manager and onsite coordinators
* Interface with the customer representatives as and when needed


 Should be ready to travel to customers locations on need basis Preferred Skills:
   

  

* Temenos Data Migration Tools (DMX, DM Studio, DM Framework)
* Temenos T24 / Private Wealth Core expertise
* ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) process design and optimization
* Source\-to\-Target Mapping aligned with Temenos data structures
* Data Transformation, Validation, and Reconciliation
* SQL / PL\-SQL and Database Management
* Performance Tuning for large\-scale migration
* Legacy System Analysis and data extraction strategies
* Migration Script Development using Temenos tools
* Job Scheduling Tools (e.g., AWA)
* Logging and Monitoring Tools (Tivoli, Dynatrace, Splunk)
* Ability to define migration strategy and roadmap
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing experience
* Experience in managing large migration teams and cross\-functional collaboration
* Project planning, resource allocation, and status reporting
* Mentoring and training team members on migration best practices


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Test Analyst
description:
Dear Candidate,
   

  

 Greetings from Cognizant..!
   

  

 \#SFDC Kochi
   

  

 We are hiring for Kochi based candidate
   

  

**Please Find The Below Job Description For Your Reference.**
 Experience \- 4 \- 10 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Serve as a test analyst within a hybrid work model focusing on end to end validation of contact center journeys supported by IVR systems and cloud platforms. Apply structured agile testing practices using Jira and Scrum to ensure reliable customer interactions and robust channel experiences delivering high quality outcomes that support organizational goals and improve service reliability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute comprehensive test analysis and design activities for IVR solutions integrated with AWS Connect to ensure reliable and efficient customer interaction flows across supported channels.
* Develop detailed test cases and test data aligned with agile user stories captured in Jira to validate functional behavior usability aspects and system stability under various contact scenarios.
* Perform systematic functional and regression testing of IVR call flows including menu navigation error handling and call routing to confirm that changes do not negatively impact existing customer experiences.
* Collaborate closely with product owners scrum team members and business analysts to clarify acceptance criteria and refine test scopes so that delivered features accurately meet documented business needs.
* Conduct end to end testing across multiple customer channels such as voice self service and assisted service journeys to verify seamless transitions and consistent experience regardless of entry point.
* Coordinate day to day test execution within Scrum ceremonies by providing clear progress updates raising impediments early and contributing to sprint planning through realistic test effort estimates.
* Analyze defects identified during test cycles by capturing clear reproduction steps in Jira and partnering with developers to support quick resolution and robust verification of applied fixes.
* Apply agile testing practices including continuous validation and early feedback to improve feature quality reduce rework and accelerate delivery of stable contact center capabilities.
* Review requirements and solution designs for IVR and AWS Connect components to identify testability gaps and propose practical improvements that support reliable automation and efficient manual validation.
* Document test results expected outcomes and observed behaviors in an organized manner to provide traceability from requirements through execution and support audit or compliance needs.
* Support continuous improvement of test processes by suggesting enhancements to test templates review practices and automation opportunities that increase coverage and reduce cycle time.
* Contribute to quality metrics reporting for the agile team such as defect trends test coverage and readiness indicators to inform decision making before production releases.
* Assist in assessing channel related business scenarios by validating real world customer journeys and highlighting potential experience issues that could impact satisfaction and operational efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate practical experience in using Jira for test management defect tracking and agile collaboration with at least two years of hands on involvement in project delivery.
* Show strong familiarity with Scrum practices including participation in sprint planning daily standups reviews and retrospectives while aligning testing activities with iterative delivery.
* Exhibit proven capability in IVR testing by designing and executing voice call scenarios validating prompts and ensuring accurate routing behavior within complex call flows.
* Possess relevant experience in testing solutions built on AWS Connect or similar cloud based contact center platforms with an understanding of configuration impacts on call handling.
* Apply solid agile mindset by embracing incremental testing continuous feedback and cross functional collaboration to maintain high quality outcomes in a fast paced environment.
* Demonstrate good analytical and problem solving skills by interpreting requirements identifying edge cases and resolving ambiguities that could affect test coverage and reliability.
* Bring helpful exposure to channels domain knowledge such as multi touch customer journeys or omnichannel service strategies which enables realistic and meaningful test scenario design.
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model by managing time communication and collaboration tools to keep testing activities synchronized with onsite and remote team members.
* Communicate clearly in both written and spoken form to convey test findings risk assessments and recommendations in a concise manner to stakeholders across technology and business.
* Maintain professional adaptability within day shifts by supporting planned release schedules and participating in occasional extended validation windows when project timelines demand.

title: VSSE Delivery Manager
description:
The Delivery Manager, VSSE\-IT Systems Engineering, is responsible for leading the delivery and operational performance of technology solutions supporting Ford’s vehicle software and systems engineering. The role oversees PLM and Teamcenter capabilities, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, DevOps, application development, and AI/ML\-enabled engineering tools. This role will develop high\-performing teams, establish delivery priorities, manage strategic technology initiatives, and ensure solutions meet organizational standards for security, quality, reliability, scalability, and business value.
   

  

* Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of VSSE\-IT software platforms, modeling ecosystems, and engineering data capabilities.
* Define and execute technology roadmaps supporting systems engineering, digital engineering, product development, traceability, collaboration, and enterprise data integration.
* Provide technical leadership for Siemens Teamcenter customization tools such as VSEM, IVS and PLM integrations, including product structures, bills of materials, requirements management, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* Oversee Teamcenter architecture, customization, administration, upgrades, environment management, troubleshooting, data synchronization, and operational readiness.
* Lead integrations between Teamcenter, MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, MBSE tools, requirements platforms, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Apply integration technologies and configuration tools such as REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable PLM technologies.
* Manage and mentor cross\-functional engineering teams responsible for full\-stack development, cloud platforms, DevOps, quality, cybersecurity, and production operations.
* Guide the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, Angular or React, RESTful APIs, databases, and GCP cloud\-native services.
* Establish and improve DevOps practices, including Kubernetes/OpenShift, containerization, Jenkins or Tekton, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure automation.
* Advance AI/ML\-enabled engineering capabilities through the integration of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, analytics platforms, AI APIs, and intelligent modeling workflows.
* Partner with Siemens Product Development to address core product issues and coordinate the development and delivery of customer\-specific patches and fixes.
* Collaborate with product owners, systems engineers, architects, PLM teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to prioritize delivery, manage risks, and conduct architecture and production\-readiness reviews.
* Promote engineering excellence through Agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, code reviews, quality practices, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Ensure VSSE\-IT solutions meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, data quality, traceability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and user adoption.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, technology delivery, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience with Product Lifecycle Management platforms, including PLM customization, integrations, product structures, bills of materials, requirements, workflows, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* At least 3 years of experience in people management, engineering management, delivery leadership, or a comparable technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software products and platforms using Agile, Scrum, or other iterative development methodologies.
* Strong technical experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, Python, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-native applications using GCP, OpenShift or Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, Tekton or Jenkins, and Terraform.
* Experience leading PLM integrations with engineering, MBSE, ERP, requirements management, or enterprise data systems using REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with data platforms, analytics solutions, AI/ML initiatives, or engineering data integration programs. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and TensorFlow is a plus.
* Proven ability to establish technical direction, manage delivery risks, improve engineering processes, and deliver secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, decision\-making, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high\-performing teams and partner effectively with engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, PLM, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, Teamcenter X, 3DEXPERIENCE, or comparable PLM platforms.
* Knowledge of PLM data models, product structures, BOMs, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, and configuration management.
* Experience with PLM integrations, migrations, APIs, customization, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Familiarity with MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, SysML, Codebeamer, VIATRA, or similar MBSE tools.
* Knowledge of automotive product development, systems engineering, digital engineering, or regulated environments.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, distributed systems, AI/ML applications, LLMs, and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with GCP, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, CI/CD, containers, observability, and cloud security.
* Experience leading distributed or global engineering teams in a collaborative, inclusive environment.

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 The Global Payment Operations (GPO) organization delivers global wire transfers and ACH payments for internal and external bank clients and supports end\-to\-end payment execution and investigations for transactions initiated through various channels. The team also provides sanctions screening on transactions for multiple products, in accordance with policies established by the Global Economic Sanctions Compliance team.
   

  

 Global Payments Support \& Enablement (GPSE) CoE is responsible for various Testing / Change Management engagements encompassing Payment platforms for EMEA, APAC, US and Canada regions. GPSE resources ensure Enterprise Change documentation and procedures are followed for compliance to the Change MRA2 governance.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This job is responsible for managing medium to large projects for an operations department or Line of Business. Key responsibilities include coordinating execution across stakeholders and test groups, managing project scope, planning, organizing and governing the test execution and working closely with management on project impact and direction. Job expectations include acting as the first point of contact for end\-to\-end project status, project health, mitigation, and timely escalation to leadership and stakeholders. They will also define the project scope to others outside of operations that may become involved in or impacted by the project. This role requires a thorough knowledge of the operations area to be able to assess and analyze the impact of new initiatives to the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Manages and directs project parameters, costs, project testing execution, and resource allocation.
* Partners with operations management on creating project impact and providing direction and guidance to internal teams.
* Coordinates development of key project deliverables in partnership with various key internal and external business partners
* Manages and leads the execution of multiple and often competing priorities to meet deadlines and adhere with policies and procedures.

* Leads defect resolution and roadblock clearing efforts to enable successful completion of testing.
* Acting as the primary point of contact and integration for the assigned projects
* Driving the end\-to\-end integration of various work streams to deliver the intended project solution, including requirements gathering, data mapping, project execution, integration and implementation.
* Coordinating execution, manage project scope, planning, organizing and governing the test execution
* Obtaining and aligning resources to key project roles
* Directing the work efforts of resources that may be functionally aligned as part of the project.
* Managing the project scope, timeline and budget/expenses
* Establishing clearly defined responsibilities and accountabilities across project participants
* Leading risk management and mitigation planning readiness, change adoption, stakeholder management, and quality assurance.
* Ensuring all applicable change requirements are satisfied.

description:
**Project Role :** 
 Quality Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Enables full stack solutions through multi\-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end\-to\-end testing process.

 Test Management
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Quality Management

**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 Software Quality Engineers design, create, implement, and monitor processes that ensure that the final product satisfies end users needs and requirements, while also making sure no other influence will cause the product to malfunction.
   

  

 Being able to fully understand what project managers and product owners expect, and to imagine what end users need and how they will interact with the product are just some of the points that a Soft\-ware Quality Engineer has to be able to fulfill.
   

  

 Clear and precise communications enable a Quality Assurance Engineer to address identified problems quickly to relevant partners in other teams and make a valuable contribution to improving the overall product quality.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback.
   

  

 Create detailed, comprehensive and well\-structured test plans and test cases to identify software problems.
   

  

 Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities.
   

  

 Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs.
   

  

 Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved.
   

  

 Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products.
   

  

 Liaise with internal teams (e.g. product leads and developers) to identify system requirements.
   

  

 Investigate the causes of non\-conforming software.
   

  

 Work together with software developers to enhance and im\-prove software.
   

  

 Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts.
   

  

 Stay up to date with new testing tools and test strategies.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

 BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject or comparable qualifications/experience.
   

  

 Proven work experience in software development or in soft\-ware quality assurance.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes.
   

  

 Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans, test cases and defect descriptions.
   

  

 ISTQB or related certification is preferable.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Test Management.
* This position is based at our Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Scrum Master, AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master
   

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.
   

  

 You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.
   

  

**We'll Look To You To Demonstrate**
* Experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Agile frameworks, and SAFe practices.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex technology initiatives
* Experience of automated testing frameworks

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a Test Lead for manufacturing execution solutions overseeing validation and automated testing for complex MES environments that integrate levels L2 to L4 and leverage generative AI capabilities. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure robust quality regulatory compliance and reliable delivery of Camstar MES solutions in a hybrid work model for global manufacturing and supply chain programs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end test planning for MES validation programs by defining scope objectives estimations and timelines that align with project milestones and quality expectations for global manufacturing stakeholders.
* Oversee design of comprehensive test strategies that cover MES Val automated testing MES Val manual testing and integration scenarios across MES L2 L3 and L4 layers to assure resilient and predictable system behavior.
* Drive creation and maintenance of detailed test cases and test scripts for Camstar MES flows to validate production quality and supply chain processes while complying with internal quality standards and external regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate execution of manual and automated test cycles in a hybrid work environment ensuring that test data environments and tools are prepared in advance to avoid delays and rework.
* Provide hands on guidance in configuring and running automated test suites for MES workflows including regression and performance tests to increase test coverage and reduce release cycle time.
* Analyze complex defects discovered during MES validation and integration testing perform structured root cause analysis and work closely with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution and prevention actions.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain domain experts to translate process requirements into testable scenarios that reflect real world production conditions and supplier constraints.
* Leverage generative AI capabilities to accelerate test artifact creation such as test scenarios test data sets and defect summaries while ensuring that outputs are reviewed and aligned with project standards.
* Prepare clear test reports and quality dashboards that summarize execution status defect trends and release readiness so that project stakeholders can make informed go or no go decisions.
* Engage with integration teams to validate data and process flows between Camstar MES and surrounding systems at L2 L3 and L4 levels ensuring accurate timely and secure information exchange.
* Ensure adherence to organizational quality frameworks validation procedures and documentation practices so that audit readiness and traceability are maintained across all MES testing activities.
* Mentor junior testers on MES validation concepts automated testing practices and defect management workflows so that the overall capability and efficiency of the test team continuously improves.
* Coordinate with project managers and architects to identify testing risks early propose mitigation strategies and adjust test plans when project scope or timelines evolve.


**Qualifications**
* Display proven experience of ten to fourteen years in software testing with substantial tenure as a Test Lead responsible for complex enterprise applications and multi phase releases.
* Possess strong hands on expertise in MES Val automated testing and MES Val manual testing including test design execution and optimization of test coverage for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrate deep practical knowledge of MES L2 L3 and L4 integration patterns including message flows event handling and data consistency considerations across plant floor and enterprise layers.
* Show solid working experience with Camstar MES configuration workflows and validation activities so that core manufacturing and quality operations can be thoroughly verified before deployment.
* Apply understanding of generative AI concepts and tools to support test documentation generation test data creation and exploratory test design under appropriate review and governance.
* Bring domain exposure in manufacturing and supply chain processes such as production execution material management quality tracking and traceability in order to design realistic and risk focused test scenarios.
* Utilize strong skills in defect management test management and collaboration tools along with clear communication capabilities to partner effectively with distributed cross functional teams in a hybrid work setup.
* Maintain a continuous learning mindset by staying current with advances in MES technologies automated testing frameworks and AI driven quality engineering practices relevant to the role.

title: Project Quality Specialist
description:
FE fundinfo is a global leader in investment fund data and technology. We are proud of our vast, diverse, and highly skilled team, who help to make our industry Better Connected and Better Informed.
   

  

 The Client Experience team plays a pivotal role in collaborating with business development and account managers throughout the client's journey. As one of the most substantial divisions at FE fundinfo, the Client Experience department is tasked with the effective execution of projects within the company's portfolio. Encompassing client support, data support, GFRS, managed services and the client success team, our objective is to provide unparalleled client service. The function of Client Experience is to guarantee that our clients receive the utmost value and satisfaction from our products and services.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing and supporting the locally based Project Quality team within the Client Delivery Team. The Project Quality Specialist will share knowledge and experience within the team to ensure that the team follows best practices and provide advice where needed.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing the Test Phases within projects that are being tested by your Test Team direct reports; thereby ensuring that the client is provided the highest quality assurance.
   

  

 The role will also form part of an operating model for existing services provided to clients. As a Project Quality Specialist you will have a strong test management knowledge and will be able to provide support to other Project Quality Specialists to ensure the highest quality in Integration and System Testing.
   

  

**Your key responsibilities as a Project Quality Specialist will be to:**
* Communicate escalations to manager where appropriate.
* Nurture an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture.
* Continuously develop and optimise team processes to improve overall performance.
* Assist with the preparation of project test plans that outlines the test objectives, schedule, deliverables, test environment setup. It serves as a blueprint for the testing activities and ensures that the team follows a structured approach.
* Collaborate with the test team and project team to create test scenarios and cases that cover all the possible functionalities and requirements of the configured application. They ensure that the test cases are comprehensive and effective and adhere to the test strategy.
* Review test artefacts, such as test cases, test scripts and test data, to ensure their quality, consistency and adherence to the test strategy and plan.
* Consolidate and analyse the findings and prepare comprehensive test reports. These reports highlight the defects found, their severity and the overall quality of the configured application.
* Track and manage defects using a defect tracking system, liaising with developers to resolve defects promptly.
* Assess the effectiveness of the testing process, identify areas for improvement and implement changes to enhance the quality and efficiency of the testing activities.
* To adhere to all general security responsibilities as documented in the company security policy


**To join us as a Project Quality Specialist you will need the following experience and skills:**
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* At least 1 years' experience with test management or similar
* Ability to work with data effectively to ensure quality testing
* Experience with project processes and procedures
* Experience with analysing and compiling data for reporting purposes
* Good technical knowledge/background


**By joining the team as a Project Quality Specialist, you will be offered the following:**
* 24 days holiday
* Paid Study leave
* Enhanced paternity \& maternity
* Statutory benefits like PF, Gratuity, etc
* Support to set up home office
* Health cover with option to add family members
* Annual health check up
* Meal cards

title: Quality Engineering Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Quality Engineering Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Develop end\-to\-end testing architectures using new and innovative testing products and solutions. Provide technical leadership and strategic direction in quality engineering.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Functional Test Planning
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Quality Engineering Architect, a typical day involves designing comprehensive testing frameworks that span the entire software development lifecycle. This role focuses on creating innovative testing solutions and architectures that enhance product quality and reliability. The position requires providing strategic guidance and technical leadership to ensure that quality engineering practices align with organizational goals and industry advancements. Collaboration with various teams to integrate testing methodologies and continuously improve testing processes is a key aspect of the daily routine.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Execute test cases accurately and can follow test steps.
* Perform functional (ST/SIT) and regression testing.
* Raise defects with clear steps to replicate and evidence.
* Can understand User Stories or BRD.
* Domain Knowledge \- experience working in any Banking domain so tester will understand quickly what to test and can raise correct defects.
* Attention to detail and proper time management to meet test cycles.
* Experience in Test management/defect tools (i.e Jira).
* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Lead efforts to identify and implement improvements in testing strategies and processes.
* Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of quality objectives with project goals.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Functional Test Planning.
* Strong knowledge of designing and implementing test architectures for complex software systems.
* Experience in developing scalable and maintainable test frameworks.
* Ability to analyze and optimize testing processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Familiarity with various testing methodologies and quality assurance best practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with a focus on delivering high\-quality solutions.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Functional Test Planning.
* This position is based at our Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Change & Release Analyst
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Developing release plans, timelines, and resource allocation for software releases.
* Collaborating with development, QA, SRE, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth release process.
* Identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with software releases.
* Ensuring that releases meet quality standards and that testing protocols are followed.
* Identifying areas for improvement in the release management process and implementing changes to optimize it
* Maintaining documentation for release processes and communicating release status to stakeholders.


**Business**
* Acquire adequate knowledge in both technology and domain that would help in better delivery


**Processes**
* A solid understanding of Change \& Release Management Processes.
* Experience and knowledge of change management principles, methodologies and tools Such as Service Now / Remedy.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal and Ability to clearly articulate communication to a variety of audiences.
* Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships across teams.
* Well Organised, Flexible and adaptable: Able to work in ambiguous situations including Weekend CR Implementations /Supporting CR’s during Non\-Production working hours.
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with the team and stakeholders.
* Knowledge on SCM (Software Configuration Management) process.


**People \& Talent**
* Ability to coordinate with the Business and Development team to get the CR Requirements
* To Prepare the Change Request Implementation plan in consultation with relevant teams (Including development team)
* Ensuring AIG, ASRM, Scripts and other Artefacts related to the CR are in place.
* Work with development team and ensure the Code is getting checked in to the ADO and release is tagged with the CR.
* Ensure the Implementation plan \& AIG with detailed UVT \& Rollback plan are in place.
* Ensure the SIT/OAT/UAT Testing Signoff’s and OLA/SLA are in place before the CR is raised.
* Provide Walkthrough to the PSS, Implementers and Approvers to seek for the CR Approvals in Remedy.
* Ensure TSM / TAM Approvals got requested and received.
* Ensure CTM (if applicable) approvals got requested and received.
* Complete change management assessment including the Impact analysis of all the weekend CR’s (Validating the timing and implementation plans of all the weekend CR’s)
* Coordinate efforts with all the approvers and Implementers.
* Evaluate and ensure user readiness for UVT, Sanity Check etc.
* Ensure the CR is fully approved in Remedy and coordinate with Change Management to move the CR to Implementation ready State.
* During the CR Period, coordinate with multiple teams to ensure the respective tasks are carried out on time and conformation is received as well.
* Work with Development team to Integrate change management activities into project plan (If needed)
* Manage stakeholders during the CR Process, Implementation and during UVT.
* Track and report issues.
* Define and measure /monitor change progress.


**Risk Management**
* The ability to identify the Application related key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures


**Governance**
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Skills And Experience**
* ADO
* eSDLC
* Stakeholder communication


**Qualifications**

 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other.
