title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: Senior Project Associate
description:
At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor\-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.
   

  

 As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Associate at ICON, you will be responsible for assisting in the planning and execution of projects, ensuring efficient operations and successful outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will take ownership of project and programme management deliverables, applying your expertise to complex challenges.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Supporting the development and execution of project plans, focusing on administrative and operational tasks.
* Assisting in the coordination of project activities, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and documenting minutes.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth project operations and communication.
* Providing guidance and support to junior associates, fostering a culture of efficiency and continuous improvement.
* Contributing to the development of project documentation and reports to present findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
* Staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to integrate best practices into project support strategies.
* Participating in project planning and decision\-making processes, ensuring the integrity and transparency of project support activities.


**Your Profile**
 You will have a strong foundation in project and programme management, with the experience to work independently and guide others.
   

  

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Years of Experience : 0\.6 \- 6years
* A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Significant experience in project management and support, with a proven track record of assisting successful projects in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
* Proficiency in project management tools and software, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Detail\-oriented, with strong problem\-solving skills to address project challenges effectively.


**What ICON Can Offer You**
 Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
   

  

 In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well\-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
   

  

**Our Benefits Examples Include**
* Various annual leave entitlements
* A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
* Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
* Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24\-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well\-being.
* Life assurance
* Flexible country\-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.


 Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Consultant, Customer Experience & Business Process Improvement (CX&BPI)
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

* Do you want to make an impact through large\-scale digital and business transformation?
* Are you curious and collaborative, with the ability to influence key decision\-makers?
* Would you like to join a dynamic and diverse team in an organization that provides continuous learning, flexible working, career growth and award\-winning benefits?


**What You’ll Do**
 As a senior CX\&BPI Consultant, you will be solving HPE Operations’ toughest problems, driving strategic transformation, improvement and experience programs, and delivering strategic innovation for the organization. This can include performing diagnostics to understand problems, applying problem solving methodologies, creating business cases for solutions, defining and establishing program structure and governance frameworks, establishing KPI measurement, benchmarking, executive steering committee or QBRs, stakeholder management, financial management, change management etc.
   

  

 At HPE, we bring together the brightest minds to create breakthrough technology solutions and advance the way people live and work. Our legacy inspires us as we forge ahead dedicated to helping our customers make their mark on the world. We’re solving the world’s most complex challenges, and our people are at the forefront of progress.
   

  

 The
 **Customer Experience \& Business Process Improvement (CX \& BPI)**

 **vision** 
 is to be the team that shapes and drives what’s next for HPE. Our
 **mission** 
 is to turn bold ideas \& complex challenges into sustainable business impact, powered by breakthrough innovation \& world\-class customer experience.

* A competitive salary and award\-winning benefits
* A diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture and team
* Growth through professional development, on\-the job learning and stretch assignments
* A network of talented and motivated colleagues
* Work\-life balance and support for career development


**What You Need To Bring**
* Facilitate the definition of business/operations strategy for a focused program or diagnostic, by engaging and influencing senior leaders
* Lead cross\-functional transformation projects defining opportunities, building solutions, implementing solutions across different teams
* Apply frameworks and best practices to evaluate the transformation program’s readiness to launch, develops action plans, leads program mobilization efforts, and provides advisory and program management services throughout the life of the program
* Evaluate and analyze data to support business strategy/operations improvements
* Re\-engineer processes to improve delivery, reduce complexity, reduce waste and incorporate accountability to sustain the change
* Define and execute change management initiatives in support of strategy and process changes to include stakeholder assessments and communications
* Foster organization wide collaboration in solving problems

**Required**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Engineering or equivalent or Relevant experience leading cross\-functional, strategic or transformation projects.
* Experience leading transformation/improvement programs; define and establish program structure and governance frameworks, business case management, KPI measurement, benchmarking, lead executive steering committee or QBR, stakeholder management, financial management, problem solving

**Preferred**
* Project management certification such as PMP/PMI certification
* Lean Six Sigma or equivalent improvement framework
* Change management experience
* Management Consulting experience
* Advanced facilitation skills
* Previous experience in the technology industry


**Skills**
* Growth Mindset: curious; continually learns and applies knowledge; challenges existing thinking and practices; contributes and adopts new ideas and approaches.
* Collaborative: works well with others; builds strong relationships and trust; contributes to an environment that promotes effective teamwork and strong collaboration
* Adaptable communicator: ability to clearly and effectively convey ideas and updates (in both verbal and written communication) across all levels of the organization.
* Goal orientated: works independently, directing their initiative, ownership and energy to getting things done and achieving results.
* Flexible and Organized: professional and structured approach to program delivery; ability to work under pressure and to tight timescales with minimal supervision.

* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary

title: Project Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 Earning Curve provides expert consulting services that help organizations design, plan, execute, manage, and support their business capabilities and technology solutions effectively. The company focuses on aligning technology initiatives with strategic business goals to drive measurable results. Clients benefit from tailored guidance that improves operational efficiency, governance, and scalability. Earning Curve’s consulting approach emphasizes practical, outcome\-driven solutions and long\-term partnership with its clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Lead is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end delivery of client projects. The role involves coordinating project planning, defining scope and timelines, and managing resources to ensure milestones are met. The Project Lead will collaborate closely with clients and internal teams, facilitate requirements gathering, and translate business needs into actionable tasks. Daily responsibilities include monitoring project progress, identifying risks, resolving issues, preparing status reports, and ensuring adherence to quality standards and agreed budgets. The role also includes mentoring team members, supporting continuous improvement, and contributing to best practices in project execution.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and coordinating with clients and technical experts in a consulting or services environment.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear project deliverables and track outcomes against defined objectives.
* Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid approaches).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present updates and recommendations to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving, decision\-making, and conflict\-resolution abilities in fast\-paced project settings.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are an advantage.
* Prior experience managing technology or business transformation projects and familiarity with consulting engagements is preferred.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements for enterprise applications and digital platforms. The Business Analyst will play a key role in bridging business needs with technical solutions by translating requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and other delivery artifacts that support successful implementation. This role requires strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, along with a solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies and agile delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather and document business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for process improvements and system enhancements
* Create and maintain requirement artifacts including BRD, FRD, User Stories, Process Flows, Use Cases, Wireframes/Mockups, and Functional Specifications
* Facilitate requirement gathering workshops, stakeholder discussions, and walkthrough sessions
* Work closely with development and QA teams to clarify requirements and support solution implementation
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand\-ups, and UAT support
* Support testing activities by reviewing test cases, validating requirements coverage, and assisting in defect triage
* Perform data analysis and validation using SQL queries and other analytical tools
* Assist with production support activities including issue analysis, root cause identification, and requirement clarification
* Ensure requirements are traceable, complete, and aligned with business objectives
* Communicate project updates, risks, dependencies, and requirement changes effectively with stakeholders


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field
* 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst
* Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies including Agile/Scrum
* Experience gathering and documenting functional and non\-functional requirements
* Hands\-on experience creating Process Flows, Use Case Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, Wireframes, and User Stories
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Experience working with cross\-functional business and technology teams
* Good understanding of APIs, JSON, XML, and system integrations
* Experience writing SQL queries for data validation and analysis
* Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, MS Excel, MS Visio, PowerPoint, and Word
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise web applications or customer\-facing platforms
* Experience in Finance, Billing, Payments, ERP, or SAP\-related projects
* Familiarity with cloud\-based applications and integrations
* Experience working in distributed/global teams
* Knowledge of UAT coordination and release support activities


**Key Skills**
* Requirements Gathering
* Business Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Agile/Scrum
* SDLC
* Functional Specifications
* Process Modeling
* SQL
* API Analysis
* Data Validation
* Problem Solving
* Communication Skills
* JIRA \& Confluence

* Strong collaboration and communication skills

title: Project Executive - Cloud - Products
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Program Manager** 
 to drive and manage key initiatives around
 **Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) process simplification, Order Management system enhancements, and data migration** 
 .
   

  

 The role will work closely with Product, Business, Technology, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Service Delivery teams to identify improvement opportunities, drive system development, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure successful adoption of new ordering capabilities.
   

  

 A key responsibility will be
 **end\-to\-end ownership of data migration and data readiness** 
 required for new ordering journeys and system enhancements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Program manage Lead\-to\-Cash simplification and Order Management transformation initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Identify process gaps, manual interventions, and improvement opportunities across the L2C and ordering journey.
* Coordinate with Business and Technology teams to define requirements and drive PRD development for system enhancements.
* Own the overall program plan, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and stakeholder communication.
* Drive execution of multiple cross\-functional initiatives and ensure timely delivery of committed outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end data migration activities, including data assessment, mapping, cleansing, data building, validation, reconciliation, and migration to target systems.
* Coordinate with business and technology teams to ensure data readiness for new products, customers, services, and ordering journeys.
* Drive UAT, rollout, production readiness, and post\-deployment stabilisation.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes — efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements — not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders — written, verbal, and in the room.


**\#Fulltime, \#Full\-time** 
**\#Associate**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 As a member of the Financial Risk \& Governance (FR\&G) Testing Team, the Senior Associate will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across FR\&G functions. This role plays a critical part in validating system enhancements, risk tooling, regulatory‑driven changes, and new technology solutions prior to production deployment.
   

  

 The Senior Associate will lead UAT planning and execution for releases, including defining UAT scope/approach, coordinating stakeholder engagement, ensuring audit\-ready sign\-off. This role will work closely with Risk Users, Product Owners, Technology Delivery Teams, and Business Analysts to ensure new capabilities meet the expectations and control needs of the Financial Risk \& Governance organization prior to production release. Testing is performed in a controlled non‑production environment designed to simulate production as closely as possible.
   

  

 Success in this role requires a strongly inquisitive mindset, an ability to understand a day‑in‑the‑life of Risk users, and a passion for improving both processes and systems. The Senior Associate will also contribute to the automation of UAT and help increase testing efficiency and repeatability across the organization.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Integration, Collaboration, and Discovery
   

  

* Support an environment that ensures employees understand how their efforts contribute to overall business strategy
* Manage assigned book of work, partnering with leadership to plan the future supply and demand of resources required
* Evaluate the testing status of assigned projects while identifying and escalating critical risks
* Partner closely with Financial Risk and Governance teams to understand functional workflows, risk processes, and control expectations.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Delivery Teams to shape epic‑level acceptance criteria, ensuring they properly reflect FR\&G user needs and regulatory considerations.
* Develop a strong understanding of end‑to‑end risk processes, including how users interact with systems, data, and controls.
* Partner with team to ensure maintenance of UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.
* Maintain UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.


 UAT Planning, Execution and Governance
   

  

* Drive UAT status governance (daily/regular reporting, risk/issues escalation, defect triage coordination) within Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) or similar lifecycle tools, ensuring all acceptance criteria are validated.
* Mentor testers; standardize templates, evidence expectations, and execution discipline.
* Define UAT approach/plan for assigned projects and oversee execution across testers/workstreams
* Lead UAT scope definition, user acceptance validation, and support change/release readiness decisions.
* Ensure final UAT package is complete (templates, statistics, evidence) and stored appropriately at end of UAT.
* Analyze and interpret business requirements, risk policies, and control objectives to develop comprehensive user test plans and test cases.
* Review test plans and cases with business partners and obtain sign‑off to confirm comprehensive test coverage aligns with approved UAT scope and established entry criteria.
* Execute UAT in representative non‑production environments, ensuring functional behavior aligns with expectations and supports control effectiveness.
* Discover, report, and track defects using JIRA, collaborating with delivery teams on resolution and retesting.
* Validate system behavior not only for “happy path” (ideal, expected flow) scenarios but also for risk‑sensitive, exception‑mode, and control‑triggering scenarios.
* Contribute to the automation of UAT test cases, partnering with QA, engineering, or automation teams as needed.


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum 6 years of related experience leading SIT/UAT planning and execution and supporting signoffs in a controlled environment
* Bachelor's degree (preferred) or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Understanding of distributed and/or mainframe test environments.
* Familiarity with SDLC/SILC, Agile, Kanban, ALM, and JIRA.
* Strong curiosity and desire to understand complex risk workflows.
* Experience in Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Model Risk, or Governance preferred.
* Experience in estimating, prioritizing, and planning testing activities
* Experience presenting to business users/stakeholders
* Experience with Intermediate MS Excel


 Willingness to build and expand skills in automation and quality assurance.
   

  

* High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline.
* Ability to think critically, ask insightful questions, and challenge assumptions.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing

**What We Offer**

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

**Process \& Data Analysis**

**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**

**Stakeholder Engagement**

description:
**Summary**
 The Software Engineering Lead is a hands\-on subject matter expert, engineering leader and people manager responsible for a cross\-functional team delivering a defined set of products and services. This role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, and people management.
   

  

 The Lead sets technical direction, ensures technical and operational excellence, and partners with Product to deliver business outcomes. Through their direct team; ensures designs have effective architectural and structural oversight, reliable products are delivered. As a peer to a Principal Software Engineer, this role is accountable for engineering outcomes (quality, reliability, security, compliance, cost, and speed) and for cultivating a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture. Analyses and aligns product roadmaps and determines the technical feasibility of future development projects. In addition will provide direction into delivery plans, schedules, raises risks and updated roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountable for ensuring good management to oversee and continuously improve the quality, service, and efficiency of staff, products and processes. Follows and enforces necessary compliance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Culture**
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws
* Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture; resolve conflict constructively; model One\-Team behaviours.
* Provides effective line management to direct reports and acts as an independent escalation point
* Conduct standard HR related duties such as absence management, performance management, disciplinaries, addressing complaints and resolving problem
* Participate in hiring processes, interviewing and develop onboarding plans of new team members
* Ensure all staff are provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible.
* Coach, mentor and support the professional development of individuals, provide with frequent feedback in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently; fostering autonomy and ownership


**Product \& Delivery Excellence**
* Own delivery outcomes: predictability, throughput, quality, and customer value—using metrics (e.g., cycle time, lead time, escaped defects, change failure rate).
* Drive planning, capacity \& dependency management; ensure delivery plans are feasible and transparent.
* Balance product growth opportunities with technical enablement (tech debt, reliability, security) using clear trade\-off decisions.
* Serve as engineering voice in roadmap prioritisation and discovery; ensure requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to architecture constraints.
* Collaborate with direct reports and various stakeholders to support the development and maintenance of the technical roadmap, ensuring roadmap planning is well thought out technically and will be successful
* Proactively surface risks and mitigations; manage external dependencies and vendor/partner engagement.
* Serve as the initial point of escalation for software development issues within the specific area of responsibility leading on
* Manage and encourage new ideas from team members to foster improvements through innovations
* Interface with Product, UX, other technical personnel, or team members to finalise requirements
* Write and reviews portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity
* Work closely with other development team members to understand moderately complex product requirements and translate them into software designs
* Ensure platform and features are compliant


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**
* Align with domain/platform tech leads and the architecture function to drive standards, patterns, and reusability.
* Collaborate with team and domain tech leads on platform architecture, cross functional requirements and complex data models
* Ensure API and integration designs are robust, reliable and fault tolerant, versioned, observable, secure, and well\-documented.
* Ensure sufficient \& relevant technical documentation is available so that any staff can get up to speed quickly with the technical concerns of the product and services leading on
* Maintain a healthy technical estate: modernisation, simplification, deprecations; manage technical debt with a transparent backlog and guardrails, so that the technical burden is kept in equilibrium
* Provide technical assurance for the team: designs, code quality, reviews, and architectural alignment.
* Ensure security practices and standards are adopted within the team leading and acceptance criteria, with regular security testing is scheduled across all products and services leading on
* Ensure suitable dashboards are developed and enhanced to highlight technical concerns, risks and KPIs
* Keep abreast of new technology developments
* Lead system design at scale, using ADRs, C4 or similar; ensure architectural decisions are traceable and pragmatic.
* Champion modern design principles: SOLID, DDD, event\-driven architectures, CQRS where appropriate.


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure zero/minimal downtime deployments (blue/green, canary); enforce release readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices and operational processes
* Own operational readiness: instrumentation, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerts; production “run” quality.
* Define SLIs/SLOs/SLA and error budgets; drive MTTR, availability, and performance targets.
* Lead incident response and blameless post\-incident reviews; ensure actionable follow\-ups and learning loops
* Ensure software is maintained and upgrade as appropriate
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) plans and are well practiced; ensure compliance for resilience and recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).
* Ensure suitable testing is in place for all services and external interfaces managed are performant, scalable, fault tolerant, reliable and future capacity modelling is considered and performance targets are in defined
* Resolve complex technical issues and complete complex bug fixes as necessary
* Own cloud cost awareness (FinOps\-lite): budgeting inputs, cost\-to\-serve, scaling policies, right\-sizing, elasticity.
* Drive performance efficiency: load testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, and scalable architectures.


**Qualifications**
* A polygot with a wide range of experience of different technologies and systems
* Proven experience as a Tech Lead / Lead Engineer delivering software at scale
* Strong organizational and project planning, time management and change management skills across functional groups
* Advanced problem solving and leading/co\-ordinating people across teams as necessary to troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues and get beyond symptoms to identifying root cause
* Focus more on the design and configuration of new systems to meet user requirements than on the implementation, technical support and evaluation of existing systems
* Demonstrable success leading cross\-functional teams through full SDLC to production.
* Experience in systems analysis, design and a solid understanding of development, quality assurance and integration methodologies
* Experienced developing integrated solutions within a broad technical and business context of significant impact
* Experience balancing product delivery with technical investments (security, reliability, debt).
* Experienced in evaluating and participated in competitive analysis of 3rd party software and services
* Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills
* Skilled in stakeholder management and communicating effectively at multiple levels (engineers → executives)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field of work or equivalent work experience \#


**Skills**
* Advanced knowledge of agile software development methodologies (Scrum, XP, Pair programming, 3\-Amigos, DevSecOps )
* Expertise in various development languages and interfaces such as c\#/.netcore, JavaScript (JQuery, ReactJS), Java, Node.Js, Python, Web, MVC, Restful APIs, GraphQL, CSS, Swagger
* Strong knowledge of SOLID Principles, KISS, YAGANI, Design patterns, Domain Modelling, DDD, CQRS, Event Driven Architectures, micro\-services and message Queues, feature toggles, SOA, and software\-as\-a\-service
* Broad knowledge of Continuous Testing, TDD / BDD, Integration Tests, Performance \& Scalability Testing, Instrumentation (Logging, monitoring, alerting, metrics, health checks)
* Strong knowledge of relational and document based data stores, with strong understanding of normalised/dimensional data modelling principles and data manipulation languages including optimisation techniques
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, Security \& Privacy By Design, SAST/DAST, Encryption, TLS, Secure Coding, Threat Modelling
* Strong knowledge of cloud based hosting, IaC, Immutable Infrastructure and container solutions, and cost/efficiency optimisations
* Strong knowledge of Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Source Control, Build Orchestration, Artefact Repositories, Static Analysis, powershell, green\-blue deployments and canary releases.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Keep four squads honest about what they can actually ship** 




 You will run the full Scrum ceremony set, including standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retros, for two to three product squads inside a single business unit, adjusting the ceremony rhythm per squad rather than forcing one template on all of them.
 



 You will track velocity, burndown and cross\-squad dependencies, and flag the ones that are actually going to blow a release date versus the ones that will resolve themselves.
 



 You will coach product managers and engineering leads on writing stories that can actually be estimated, and push back when a story arrives with the acceptance criteria still in someone's head.
 



 You will represent delivery status upward, translating sprint\-level noise into a release picture that a VP of Engineering can act on without five follow\-up questions.
 



 This role expects four to eight years of Scrum Master or agile delivery experience, including time spent supporting more than one team at once. You should be comfortable with Jira at an administrator level, know the difference between a blocked story and a slow one, and have said no to a scope change mid\-sprint at least once. A Scrum or SAFe certification helps but is not the bar, the bar is having run this before and having the scars to show for it.
 



**The team you would be supporting** 




 This is a US\-headquartered product company scaling its India engineering hub, hiring this role through Flexiple. The India engineering org is a little over sixty people today, organised into four squads that this role will rotate support across.
 



 Bengaluru, Pune or Remote (India), with a strong preference for candidates able to overlap a few hours with the US product team.
 



 Expect a recruiter conversation, a scenario\-based round on running a multi\-squad sprint cadence, a session with two of the engineering leads you would support, and a closing conversation with the hiring manager.
 



 This application is also kept on file for other delivery and agile\-coaching roles Flexiple is hiring for alongside this one.
